outputs.summary: Kanban Play and epic Start run dialogs (shared RunWithAgentSection) have an optional "Additional instructions" field (<=32,000 chars). Trimmed non-blank text is sent as an optional instructions field on startKanbanCard/startOrchestrator (strict schemas; transfer chats got their own schema and still refuse it). Main appends it to kanbanKickoff/orchestratorKickoff as a delimited section attributed to the person, stating it applies within the card/epic scope and changes neither role, grants, Allow save, criteria nor plan (claim tokens masked). With instructions the full kickoff is also recorded as the chat firstPrompt so the existing pending/uncertain/submitted tracking delivers it exactly once across a failed first start; ChatRecord.firstPrompt limit raised to 48,000 to fit kickoff + 32,000 chars. Blank field = unchanged behaviour. docs/design/chat-shells.md and docs/runbooks/agents.md updated.
